rules: No delayed data mutation or interpolated monetary values
Repeated taps cancel the previous visual
No motion on unchanged polling values
Transfer uses a small duplicate, never the full plate
One flight at a time; pointer and focus pass through
Parent buttons and price rows keep their layout

reducedMotion: Immediate final state; cancel existing motion
integration: Plain JS custom element in existing numeric/text slots; generated generic source is packaging baseline only
